question: What is the Laplace transform of the unit step function u(t)?
solution: L{u(t)} = integral from 0 to infinity of e^(-st) dt = 1/s (for Re(s) > 0). Topic (Laplace transforms) is in the Engineering Mathematics section of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
subject: Engineering Mathematics
